note: The shape of the pre-push gate. Written in the negative: it lists exemptions, never packages, so adding a package raises the bar with no edit here. scripts/verify-gate-shape.mjs compares the running gate to this file at the end of every push.
rootsNote: A floor, not the list. Every workspace glob in the root package.json counts too, so a new workspace root raises the bar with no edit here.

checkers.note: Runs oxlint directly, not through turbo, so it leaves no run summary. It reports its own file and rule count, and the verifier compares those to a reference run made straight after the gate.
